goal: Enable script debuggers and visualizers by letting libbitcoinkernel consumers inspect execution states
Help testing and fuzzing harnesses catch internal interpreter bugs shadowed by later errors
agreement: Broad concept support and verified with downstream debugger and visualizer tools (elmeriniemela, fametrano)
Unaddressed objection: mutex locking causes contention during parallel verification (fametrano)
Answered objection: tracer misreports inactive branch control-flow opcodes as skipped (w0xlt)
Open review suggestions around API types, lifetime docs, and scope constness (stringintech)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it adds durable capabilities for external consumers to build debuggers and visualizers
Unblocks external tooling and test harnesses from inspecting intermediate interpreter execution states
